=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:14718-14842 (with scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:653-684, 894-896, 933-936) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: After the bounded hold releases a parked cycle, nothing marks that cycle as released. Its tracking issue keeps `ai:comprehensive-test-pending` and a marker saying `pinned=true`, so when it resumes, `comprehensive_release_cycle_freeze` deletes the shared `promote-cycle-frozen` tag without checking ownership (line 14723). That tag is the one the new cycle's `pin_freeze` re-created. The delete can come from the pin-release path (14824-14841) or from the paths at 14780, 14790, 14820, 15308 and 15397.
  WHY: The new cycle loses its freeze, `promote-candidate` fast-forwards past its candidate, and the new cycle records `deferred reason=pin_released`, so its promotion is abandoned. Two apply-analysis projects can also run on main at once, and no test covers resuming a released cycle. All reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh:131-134 (called via promote_cycle_hold_alert at scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:740-749 and line 896) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The hold-release path sends the Telegram WARNING synchronously through `tg_send_msg`, whose curl has no `--max-time`. The sibling Telegram calls at lines 163, 224, 331 and 689 are all bounded.
  WHY: A stalled Telegram request blocks the remaining guards and can use up the cycle job's 340-minute timeout. Four reviewers rated this MAJOR (glm's confidence was 3). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 downgraded it to a hardening suggestion because the helper behaviour predates this PR.
- README.md:264 (vs scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:293-299, 851) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The README says any value of `PROMOTE_CYCLE_HOLD_RELEASE_ENABLED` other than `true` restores the unbounded hold, but the script gates on `is_truthy`, which also accepts `1`, `yes` and `on` in any letter case.
  WHY: An operator who sets `yes` or `1` expecting the old unbounded hold gets release-after-cap instead. All reviewers rated this NIT.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:780-784 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The GraphQL label-history call in `promote_cycle_hold_history` discards stderr (`2>/dev/null`), so the "label history unavailable" warning cannot say whether the cause was auth, a rate limit or a query error.
  WHY: The guard fails closed, but the cause is hidden from operators. Only gemini rated this MAJOR; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised it only as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:824-831, 889 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `promote_cycle_hold_decide` measures the latch age from the newest event across all latch labels, but the `PROMOTE_CYCLE_HOLD_RELEASED` reason field names the first label in `PROMOTE_CYCLE_HOLD_LATCH_LABELS` order.
  WHY: The reason field can name a label whose event is not the newest, which contradicts the agents and changelog fragments ("the newest event sets the age") and misleads post-incident review.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:894-896 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A released issue that stays open and latched is decided again on every daily tick, which logs `PROMOTE_CYCLE_HOLD_RELEASED` and sends the Telegram WARNING again with no dedup marker.
  WHY: This is alert noise, not wrong behaviour, because it matches the documented contract ("logged once per released issue per tick"). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly declined to report it for the same reason.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
(No task gaps reported.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh (guard 2 call site `promote_cycle_hold_guard "${in_flight_listing}" "${in_flight}"` at lines 933-935, plus the `pin_freeze` stale-tag path at lines 653-672), interacting with scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh `comprehensive_release_cycle_freeze` (lines 14718-14734) and its callers at lines 14780, 14790, 14820, 14841, 15308 and 15397 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A released parked cycle (A) and the new cycle (B) are both open. When A resumes, every way it can end deletes B's `promote-cycle-frozen` tag without an ownership check: the pin-release path at 14824/14841, the failed or validation-failed ending at 15397, and the failed verifying dispatch at 15308.
  WHY: B loses its freeze, `promote-candidate` fast-forwards past B's candidate, and B records `deferred reason=pin_released`. No test covers this path. Suggested fixes: delete the tag only when it points at the cycle's own `promote_sha`, or mark the released cycle as unpinned or abandoned.
- README.md (`PROMOTE_CYCLE_HOLD_RELEASE_ENABLED` row) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: "Any other value restores the previous unbounded hold exactly" contradicts the `is_truthy` gate (scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh lines 293-299, line 851).
  WHY: An operator who sets `1` or `yes` gets release-after-cap.
- HARDENING (3 related items, risk score 2):
  - scripts/tg_helpers.sh `tg_send_msg` curl at line 131 has no `--max-time`. Downgraded from the pass-1 MAJOR because the behaviour predates this PR.
  - `promote_cycle_hold_decide` passes `--argjson hist "${history}"`, which can exceed MAX_ARG_STRLEN (128 KiB). Exec then fails and every tick takes the fail-closed skip.
  - `promote_cycle_hold_history` discards gh stderr with `2>/dev/null`.
- NOTES:
  - The copilot-pull-request-reviewer failure (custom_instructions_too_large) is an infrastructure failure.
  - The pre-push gate's attribution of five failing suites to this change is unverified, so it was not reported.
  - The "daily repeated WARNING" item was not reported because it matches the documented contract.
  - The label_contract.v1.json comment-path hardening item was dropped (the same path is referenced at scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh line 354).
  - Task completeness: none missing.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:896 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `promote_cycle_hold_guard` calls `promote_cycle_hold_alert`, which calls `tg_send_msg` synchronously, and that function's curl in tg_helpers.sh has no timeout.
  WHY: A hanging Telegram request blocks the promotion cycle job and can use up the 340-minute timeout.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:pin_freeze and comprehensive_release_cycle_freeze usage | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `promote-cycle-frozen` tag is shared globally, so a released parked cycle's cleanup can delete or unfreeze the new cycle's tag.
  WHY: The new cycle's promotion is abandoned, and two apply-analysis projects might run on main at once.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:780 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The GraphQL history call discards stderr (`2>/dev/null`).
  WHY: When the fetch fails, the guard fails closed but the cause is hidden from operators.
- README.md:264 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The README says any value other than true restores the unbounded hold, but `is_truthy` (line 851) accepts yes, 1 and on.
  WHY: Operators following the documentation keep the bounded hold enabled when they meant to disable it.
- HARDENING (2 related items):
  - scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:780: capture stderr for the `::warning::` (risk score 1).
  - scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:177: the comment wrongly references .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json; point it at scripts/ai_labels.py or scripts/label_helpers.sh (risk score 0).
- Task completeness: NONE.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/tg_helpers.sh: tg_send_msg at lines 131-134 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The hold-release path (scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:896) calls `tg_send_msg` synchronously, and its curl has no `--max-time`. The other curls in the file (lines 163, 224, 331, 689) are bounded at 10-30 seconds.
  WHY: A stalled api.telegram.org can make the daily cycle job use up its 340-minute cap.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (interaction with scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh): comprehensive_release_cycle_freeze at lines 14718-14734, called unconditionally with pinned=true at lines 14780, 14790, 14820, 14841; promoted cycle_in_flight bypass in scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:934-936 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The delete at line 14723 has no owner or promote_sha check. After the bounded hold releases cycle A, cycle B's `pin_freeze` re-creates the tag. A's poller then calls `comprehensive_release_cycle_freeze true` and deletes B's tag.
  WHY: B's tag is silently deleted, B records deferred reason=pin_released and its promotion is abandoned, and two apply-analysis projects can run on main at once.
- README.md: PROMOTE_CYCLE_HOLD_RELEASE_ENABLED row at line 264 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: "Any other value restores the previous unbounded hold exactly" contradicts `is_truthy` (scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:293-299, used at :851). It is also inconsistent with the PROMOTE_CYCLE_PIN_ENABLED row at line 262.
  WHY: Documentation-only mismatch that misleads operators.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh: promote_cycle_hold_decide at lines 824-825 and the release arm at line 889 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The latch age comes from the newest event across all labels, but the reason field names the first label in PROMOTE_CYCLE_HOLD_LATCH_LABELS order (line 831). This contradicts the agents and changelog fragments.
  WHY: The diagnostic is ambiguous and complicates post-incident review.
- HARDENING (2 related items, risk score 1 each):
  - scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh line 184: the comment cites the nonexistent .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json.
  - scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh lines 783-784: `2>/dev/null` hides the gh failure reason from the warning at line 861.
- NOTES:
  - The pre-push gate's five-suite attribution is a gate-side classification that needs a re-run.
  - The copilot check failure is infrastructure.
  - Task completeness: NONE.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- README.md: Line 264; scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh lines 293 and 851 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The README says any value other than `true` restores the unbounded hold, but `is_truthy` also enables release for `yes`, `1` and `on`.
  WHY: Setting `PROMOTE_CYCLE_HOLD_RELEASE_ENABLED=yes` enables release after the cap.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh lines 894-896 and 653-684; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 14718-14723 and 14824-14842 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A release only logs and alerts; it does not invalidate the parked issue's pinned cycle. When the old issue resumes, the poller unconditionally deletes the shared tag, which the new cycle has replaced.
  WHY: The new cycle sees its pin released and abandons its promotion.
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh; scripts/tg_helpers.sh: scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh lines 896 and 740-748; scripts/tg_helpers.sh lines 131-134 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The synchronous Telegram alert uses a curl with no total timeout.
  WHY: A stalled request can make the cycle job hit its 340-minute timeout.
- HARDENING: NONE.
- Task completeness: NONE.
=== END
